title: Phase 6.2.36 — 100-Word Benchmark Origin & Bias Audit Report

benchmark_construction.a1_selection_method: Hand-curated 20 canonical records from Phase 6.2.30A packet (4 APPROVE, 11 EDIT_REQUIRED, 5 HOLD) representing basic everyday nouns, verbs, adverbs.
benchmark_construction.a2_c2_selection_method: First-encountered candidate per Part-of-Speech cycling through early large batches (LARGE-001 to LARGE-010).
benchmark_construction.seed: Deterministic procedural selection (zero random floating sampling).

representativeness_comparison.explanation: The 100-word benchmark contains 40% A1/A2 words (vs 25.8% in universe) and samples foundational, high-frequency headwords with dense lexical coverage in WordNet and LEXiTRON. It is NOT representative of the broader 10,021 universe.
